title: Marvel’s Spider-Man
description: An insecure but courageous and intelligent teen named Peter Parker, a new student of Midtown High, is bitten by a radioactive spider and given powers. He becomes a hero named Spider-Man after the death of his uncle and he must adapt to this new way of life.

episodes.title: S2-E1How I Thwipped My Summer Vacation
S2-E3Between an Ock and a Hard Place

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 0x2
episodes_data.description: Peter uses science to investigate his spider bite.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 0x1
episodes_data.description: Peter Parker is on a field trip to Oscorp when he accidentally gets bitten by a radioactive spider.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 0x5
episodes_data.description: Peter enters a wrestling competition.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 0x4
episodes_data.description: Peter predicts his new abilities could bring him fame.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 0x3
episodes_data.description: Peter begins to develop super powers.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 0x6
episodes_data.description: With great power comes great responsibility.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x1
episodes_data.description: Peter is accepted into Horizon High: a school for geniuses, where his best friend Harry Osborn was just suspended. Peter makes his debut as Spider-Man and must battle the Vulture.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x2
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man must work to stop the Scorpion from wreaking havoc at the museum.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x3
episodes_data.description: Norman Osborn creates the Osborn Academy for Geniuses as a way of saving his son, Harry, the embarrassment of being suspended from Horizon High.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x4
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man must stop Black Cat from committing a spree of thefts while still keeping his school obligations.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x5
episodes_data.description: Horizon High throws a dance in honor of Harry being exonerated, but Norman asks Harry to stay at the Oz Academy.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x6
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man meets the powerful, yet uncontrollable Sandman and helps him reunite with his estranged daughter with the help of the Venom symbiote.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x7
episodes_data.description: When Spider-Man uses his new black costume, he discovers that there is great danger in his new power; and he must find a way to defeat a costume that wants to destroy him.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x8
episodes_data.description: After the terror of the symbiote, Spidey is off to the Stark Expo in his old costume. When Ghost hijacks the event, Spidey's only chance to save lives is to unleash the symbiote.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x9
episodes_data.description: When Miles Morales is bitten by an experimental spider and gains spider powers, Spider-Man must teach him the responsibilities of being a superhero.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x10
episodes_data.description: Kraven the Hunter does a live broadcast of his hunt for Spider-Man.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x11
episodes_data.description: On Halloween night, Spider-Man must team up with the incredible Hulk to stop Man-Wolf, a super-strong gamma-powered werewolf, from infecting the rest of Manhattan.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x12
episodes_data.description: Spidey must stop a low-level villain who has acquired some impressive freezing technology.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x13
episodes_data.description: The symbiote has escaped the Avengers Compound and attached itself to a new host. Now Spidey must find out how to beat it and who the new person is underneath.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x14
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man is targeted by a new costumed figure named Screwball for a series of online prank videos which block him from fighting crime.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x15
episodes_data.description: When Otto Octavius is caught in an explosion that fuses his robot arms to his body, Spider-Man sees the opportunity to recruit "The Octopus" into becoming a hero.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x16
episodes_data.description: Spidey invites The Octopus to patrol the streets alongside Miles and himself until it becomes clear that Otto isn't exactly a team player.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x17
episodes_data.description: Peter spends a day at Osborn Academy in the hopes of finding a clue that will convince Harry that his father is out to destroy Spider-Man.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x18
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man must team up with Gwen Stacy and a reluctant Harry Osborn to investigate the truth behind the missing Raymond Warren aka the Jackal.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x19
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man tracks a new villain with spider powers who steals his experimental stealth suit and threatens the entire city.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x20
episodes_data.description: Everyone in Manhattan manifests spider powers; Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen must help Black Widow track down Crossbones before he delivers the vibranium to Arnim Zola and Hydra.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x21
episodes_data.description: Peter must find a way to cure Gwen Stacy and Norman Osborn after they turn into spider monsters; things get harder when Kraven the Hunter turns New York into his hunting grounds.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x22
episodes_data.description: Peter and Harry must battle through an island of spider monsters to get to Norman Osborn, who appears to control them all; the boys discover the real mastermind.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x23
episodes_data.description: To cure the spider-monster population of Manhattan, Spider-Man must lead Kid Arachnid, Anya and Harry on a desperate, last-ditch effort to stop the Jackal.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x24
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man takes on Doc Ock and his Sinister Five before they brainwash Spidey and destroy New York City.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 1x25
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man must find a way to stop Hobgoblin, who seems completely bent on doing whatever it takes to destroy Spider-Man.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x1
episodes_data.description: Peter Parker struggles to balance the best summer vacation ever and his responsibilities as Spider-Man.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x2
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man is excited to start his second year as a superhero and as a student at Horizon High, but discovers that Doc Ock also claims to want a second chance.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x3
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man discovers there is a new Doctor Octopus taking up the mantle from Otto Octavius and finds himself drawn into this new mystery, missing the danger right under his nose.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x4
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man has to infiltrate the viral superstars known as the Wake Riders in order to figure out what the end game is with their stolen Vulture tech. But things take a dangerous turn as Adrian Toomes is tempted back to the dark side.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x5
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man teams up with Ms. Marvel to investigate an elite boarding school after its students start displaying out-of-control, super-powered behaviors.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x6
episodes_data.description: Eddie Brock, who has emerged with the vengeance-filled Venom symbiote, sets his sights on destroying Peter Parker and everything that is Spider-Man.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x7
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man is two steps behind as Venom kidnaps key figures in Peter Parker's life; demanding a face-off against Peter, Venom holds them hostage at Horizon High.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x8
episodes_data.description: A mystery villain puts a bounty on Spider-Man's head, bringing on attacks from Panda-Mania, Hippo and Overdrive.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x9
episodes_data.description: Anya must step up and embrace being the Spider-Girl; Spider-Man is lured into Mysterio's funhouse and learns that there is a bounty on his head.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x10
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man faces off against his most bizarre bad guy yet, Jack O'Lantern; he turns Prowler, a reluctant villain, to the side of heroes when he helps him save his brother.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x11
episodes_data.description: Spidey tracks the identity of the mysterious boss that put a price on his head and who has been sending villains after him.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x12
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man and Miles Morales discover Doc Ock, whose mind has been hiding inside the metal body of the Living Brain, has been behind the mysterious bounty for Spider-Man’s head.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x13
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man must fight his way through the Super-Villain Holding Facility to challenge the Living Brain, the robot body that houses the mind of Doctor Octopus.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x14
episodes_data.description: The Bloodgem accidentally reawakens Gwen Stacy's dormant spider-powers, turning her into Ghost Spider!

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x15
episodes_data.description: Doc Ock intends to bring New York to its knees, but his new brain still contains memories of Uncle Ben.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x16
episodes_data.description: Doc Ock must adjust to his new life as a hero and is tested by rising crime boss Sand Girl.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x17
episodes_data.description: Superior Spider-Man is confronted by the Avengers who suspect that he is not who he claims to be.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x18
episodes_data.description: When Cloak and Dagger emerge to take revenge against Tiberius Stone and his company, Alchemax, Superior Spider-Man must take them down to protect the school.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x19
episodes_data.description: Superior Spider-Man must face his most challenging opponent when Venom escapes from stasis and attacks Midtown High seeking revenge on Peter Parker.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x20
episodes_data.description: A series of attacks captures the Avengers one-by-one. Spider-Man is left to figure out who is behind the kidnappings.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x21
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man takes his mission to The Cellar, where he believes The Regent is using his powers of Cloak & Dagger as well as other supervillains to hold the Avengers captive.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x22
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man has to take down the slick new villain, Slyde, who is stealing various chemicals from around the city in an effort to create a deadly virus that could wipe out New York.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x23
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man must team up with Spider-Girl Ghost Spider, and Doc Ock to track down a new threat — the mysterious Goblin Nation.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x24
episodes_data.description: As Spider-Man and Harry Osborn seek the Goblin King to determine who is behind the Goblin Mask, Spider-Man becomes concerned Harry is leading him into trap.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x25
episodes_data.description: Peter Parker struggles with the duality of his social life at school and hiding his secret identity from everyone, including his best friend Harry Osborn

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2x26
episodes_data.description: Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Spider-Girl, Ghost Spider, Harry Osborn and Doc Ock must stop the Goblin King in his newly acquired Goblin Mech Suit before he destroys New York City.
